# Go module dependency license check log

Tracks the spec §7 "verify before use" gate for compiled-in Go dependencies.
The in-app Third-Party Licenses screen is generated by `go run ./tools/gen-notices`
(see docs/STATUS.md); this file is only the historical record of
what was checked and when, so M6 has a paper trail instead of starting from
scratch.

| Module | Version | License | Checked |
|---|---|---|---|
| github.com/bodgit/sevenzip | v1.6.5 | BSD-3-Clause | 2026-10-16 (M1) |
| github.com/bodgit/plumbing | v1.3.0 | BSD-3-Clause | 2026-10-16 (M1, transitive via sevenzip) |
| github.com/bodgit/windows | v1.0.1 | BSD-3-Clause | 2026-10-16 (M1, transitive via sevenzip) |
| github.com/stangelandcl/ppmd | v0.1.1 | MIT | 2026-10-16 (M1, transitive via sevenzip) |
| github.com/andybalholm/brotli | v1.2.2 | MIT-style | 2026-10-16 (M1, transitive via sevenzip) |
| github.com/pierrec/lz4/v4 | v4.1.27 | BSD-3-Clause | 2026-10-16 (M1, transitive via sevenzip) |

All permissive; no source-offer obligation like the GPL transcode tools (§7).
Re-check on every version bump, same as the GPL tools' per-release check.
